items.name: Tobira Site Agent
items.tagline: Turn your website into an AI agent that sells to AI agents
items.description: People already find you through AI. Tobira turns that AI traffic into real leads and customers. Paste your URL and in 10 minutes your website becomes an AI agent. It answers people and their AI, negotiates, books calls and takes orders right in customers' ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and other AI chats. Leads go to your Telegram or email. Also, AI agents read your site 2x faster and take action without navigating its interface. Free with your own AI key.

items.name: Turnstone
items.tagline: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free
items.description: Turnstone is a Grok Bot alternative that runs on the AI you already have. Connect your own AI subscriptions, an API key, or your self-hosted model. When one hits its usage limit, your Agent switches to another and keeps going. Works on your Mac and iPhone. Completely free.

items.name: Wonder Dev View
items.tagline: Run many Claude Code and Codex agents in parallel
items.description: Run Claude Code and Codex on your subscriptions, in parallel worktrees. Have one review the other’s code, then try your app beside the design. Select an element in Preview and tell your agent what to change.

items.name: Rankfender v3.0
items.tagline: The SEO/GEO operating system, built for people and AI agents
items.description: Built for marketers, founders and agencies tired of switching between SEO tools. Rankfender 3.0 brings keyword research, rank tracking incl. AI Overviews, competitor and backlink analysis, site audits, traffic, content and Social, and strategy into one place, and adds what the old tools miss: how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and 4 more AI assistants talk about your brand. Work in the app, or connect Claude or ChatGPT and let your AI agent run it.

items.name: Mechvibes 3
items.tagline: Give your keyboard and mouse any sound you like
items.description: Mechvibes plays a sound for every key you press and every click, in any app. Pick from the community library, from mechanical switches to typewriters and game sounds, or make your own in the browser. Free and open source, for Windows, Linux and Mac.

items.name: EdgeBar
items.tagline: Control your Mac’s volume and brightness from the trackpad
items.description: EdgeBar turns your MacBook trackpad edges into smooth volume and brightness controls, with haptic feedback. Slide the right edge for volume and the left for brightness, with the same on-screen display as the keyboard keys and a light haptic tick as you go. Double-tap the top-right corner to mute, swipe the bottom edge to skip tracks. Lives in the menu bar, uses almost no CPU. $9 once, with lifetime updates.

items.name: Meadow
items.tagline: Hidden songs on your walk, chosen by people, not algorithms
items.description: Meadow lets you plant a song at a real place. Walk by and you can listen to what someone left there, collect it, and plant your own for the next person. No algorithm, just music that people chose for a place. Collect songs with your phone in your pocket using Live Activities, keep every find in your Garden, turn it into an Apple Music playlist, and see what your city is playing in the Feed. Free on TestFlight for iPhone.

items.name: Pauta
items.tagline: Your private memory for every conversation
items.description: Pauta records and transcribes meetings, interviews and voice notes, then turns them into summaries and action items. It works fully offline, keeps your data on your device, and only connects to external AI if you choose.

items.name: Datastripes Data Stories
items.tagline: Turn any spreadsheet into a data story in seconds
items.description: Upload a CSV or Excel file and Datastripes writes the story behind it: headlines, charts and findings in plain English. Pick the questions, check your conclusion against the data, then publish in 8 formats and your brand colors. Every dataset has a story in it, but getting it out usually takes an analyst, a designer and a writer. We built Datastripes Data Story so one person with a spreadsheet can do it in minutes.

items.name: Cursor Craft
items.tagline: Custom cursors for Mac
items.description: Cursor Craft is a free macOS app for browsing, installing, and switching custom cursor sets in one click. Choose from free and premium packs across minimal, nature, neon, cats, anime, and more.

items.name: Kodivo
items.tagline: Learn coding with AI and PHP through swipeable cards
items.description: Swipe through short lessons on coding with AI and PHP. Learn how coding agents work, understand code examples, and test yourself with exercises and explained answers. Connect Codex or Claude Code through MCP to continue with your saved progress.

items.name: Winq
items.tagline: Focus on a window or display you're looking at
items.description: Gaze focus for macOS from your Mac's camera: look at a display or a window and Winq focuses it, with the pointer where you're looking. Head and eyes both count, it waits while you type or use the mouse, and it keeps learning from your clicks. For multi-monitor setups, developers, and anyone who wants their hands on the keyboard. On-device and private. Free for a day.

items.name: Pressure
items.tagline: Need a second opinion? Have two agents debate your topic
items.description: Ask a question and two AI models from different labs argue it out, then you get a pinned summary: the positions, the concessions, the conclusion, and what is still open. Debate a decision, review a spec, research with cited sources, or pressure-test a rough idea. Start a debate on the web with no signup, add Pressure to Claude as a connector, or install the CLI for Claude Code and Codex in one line.

items.name: MacDupl
items.tagline: Run every account in its own app
items.description: MacDupl turns the Mac apps you already use into separate copies, each with its own login, data and Dock icon. Work and personal side by side, no logging out. New in 0.2.0: one window for every copy, one-click updates that keep logins, and a menu bar panel.

items.name: TraceX
items.tagline: The AI engineer for your production issues
items.description: TraceX reads a customer's email, Slack message or Jira ticket, investigates your database, code and logs read-only, and returns the root cause with evidence for every claim, a fix as a pull request and a drafted reply. Free in private beta.

items.name: Any Video to Text
items.tagline: Paste a video link, get the transcript in seconds
items.description: Paste a TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook or X link and get the transcript in seconds: from the video's captions, or AI speech-to-text when it has none. You can also upload MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4 or MOV files, with speaker labels for interviews and podcasts. Cooking videos get a recipe card too. Copy, summarize, or download TXT, SRT or VTT, here or in the Chrome extension. Free for 5 a day, no sign-up. Credits unlock 2-hour videos and bulk.

items.name: Wisp
items.tagline: Wisp is a little AI fairy who lives on your desktop
items.description: Meet Wisp, your guiding light. A little fairy who lives on your desktop and does the rest. Wisp is a small spark of light that floats beside your cursor on your Mac or Windows desktop. She can see your screen, open apps, websites and files, arrange windows, and tidy folders. She also builds small software, draws sketches, makes designs, reads and replies to your email, controls your calendar, Slack, Drive and to-do lists, and plays games with you! Try Wisp for free today!

items.name: Koltrix
items.tagline: Your whole email stack, run by agents you control.
items.description: Koltrix is a team inbox on your own domain, an email API for your product, and AI agents with inboxes of their own. You choose what each agent may do: draft, ask first, or reply when it is sure. Works with Claude and ChatGPT. 7-day trial, no card.

items.name: Native Tasks for Obsidian
items.tagline: A native Mac app for your Obsidian tasks
items.description: Free native Mac task manager for people who keep tasks in Obsidian. Reads your vault's Markdown directly and writes every edit back. Tasks-plugin dates, priority, recurrence, statuses. No account, no telemetry. Pro: one-off £19.99, 7-day free trial on the direct download.

items.name: BuildFerry
items.tagline: Install iOS test builds on any iPhone with one link
items.description: Send youripa to testers with one link. BuildFerry registers each tester's iPhone with your Apple account and re-signs the build in the cloud, so there's no UDID hunting, no Mac, no TestFlight app and no App Review. Free for one app.
